row: How To Train A Dream Dog

I help new puppy parents ditch the frustration and fix unwanted behaviors like biting, barking, jumping, and potty accidents using positive training that actually works. My goal is to help you raise a calm, well-mannered puppy that has a stronger bond with you. 

On this channel, you’ll find weekly videos covering real-life puppy challenges: crate training, leash skills, routines, enrichment, and more. Everything is designed to be practical, positive, and easy to follow.

With over 25 years of experience, I’ve helped thousands of families feel confident raising their dream dog. I know how overwhelming puppyhood can be, and I’m here to guide you every step of the way.

🎁 Grab my free New Puppy Starter Kit to get started: https://learn.howtotrainadreamdog.com/yt/new-puppy-starter-kit/
